import json, statistics, time, hashlib, os
from pathlib import Path
import torch, torch_npu
from csrc.kernel.gdn_mega_bwd.backward import backward
from csrc.kernel.gdn_mega_bwd.binding import build
from test_gdn_mega import _prepare_gdn_mega, pto_gdn_mega

torch.npu.set_device(0)
torch.npu.config.allow_internal_format = False
native = build()
libraries = {line.split()[-1] for line in Path('/proc/self/maps').read_text().splitlines() if line.split()[-1].endswith('/libno_workspace_kernel.so')}
assert len(libraries)==1, libraries
forward_library = next(iter(libraries))
forward_hash = hashlib.sha256(Path(forward_library).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert forward_hash == os.environ['GDN_EXPECTED_LIBRARY_SHA256']
print(json.dumps({'device_library': native.device_library._name, 'forward_library': forward_library, 'forward_sha256': forward_hash}), flush=True)

def measure(length, heads, key_heads):
    torch.manual_seed(42)
    q = torch.randn(1,length,key_heads,128,device='npu',dtype=torch.float16)*.1
    k = torch.nn.functional.normalize(torch.randn_like(q), dim=-1)
    v = torch.randn(1,length,heads,128,device='npu',dtype=torch.float16)
    g = -torch.rand(1,length,heads,device='npu')*.1
    beta, do = torch.rand_like(g).half(), torch.randn_like(v)
    cu = torch.tensor([0,length],device='npu',dtype=torch.int32)
    launch = _prepare_gdn_mega(q,k,v,g,beta,cu)
    gates = tuple(launch[x] for x in ('g_t','g_sum','beta_t'))
    caches = {str(dt).split('.')[-1]: torch.empty(length//128,heads,128,128,device='npu',dtype=dt)
              for dt in (torch.float32, torch.float16, torch.bfloat16)}
    pto_gdn_mega(**launch)
    reference = launch['out'].clone(), launch['final_state'].clone()
    for cache in caches.values():
        pto_gdn_mega(**launch,inverse_cache=cache)
        for name, expected in zip(('out','final_state'),reference):
            torch.testing.assert_close(launch[name],expected,atol=0,rtol=0)
    for name in ('float16','bfloat16'):
        torch.testing.assert_close(caches[name],caches['float32'].to(caches[name].dtype),atol=0,rtol=0)
    torch.npu.synchronize()
    samples = {}
    for direction in ('forward','backward'):
        modes = list(caches.items()) + ([('none',None)] if direction=='forward' else [])
        for trial in range(18):
            rotated = modes[trial%len(modes):] + modes[:trial%len(modes)]
            for name, cache in rotated:
                start = time.perf_counter()
                if direction=='forward': pto_gdn_mega(**launch,inverse_cache=cache)
                else: backward(q,k,v,g,beta,do,inverse_cache=cache,gate_cache=gates)
                torch.npu.synchronize()
                if trial>=3: samples.setdefault(direction+'_'+name,[]).append((time.perf_counter()-start)*1000)
    print(json.dumps(dict(tokens=length,heads=heads,key_heads=key_heads,samples_ms=samples,
        medians_ms={k:statistics.median(v) for k,v in samples.items()},
        inverse_bytes={k:v.numel()*v.element_size() for k,v in caches.items()})),flush=True)

for shape in ((2048,16,2),(8192,16,2),(8192,64,16),(32768,64,16)):
    measure(*shape)

paired_timing.script:
import ctypes, hashlib, json, os, re, statistics, time
from pathlib import Path
import torch, torch_npu
from test_gdn_mega import _prepare_gdn_mega, pto_gdn_mega

torch.npu.set_device(0)
torch.npu.config.allow_internal_format=False
source=Path('csrc/kernel/gdn_mega/kernel_gdn_mega.cpp').read_text()
parameters=re.search(r'extern "C" void pto_launch_gdn_mega\((.*?)\)\s*{',source,re.S).group(1)
parameters=[p.strip().rsplit(' ',1) for p in parameters.split(',')]
argtypes={'uint32_t':ctypes.c_uint32,'int64_t':ctypes.c_int64,'void*':ctypes.c_void_p}
libs={name:ctypes.CDLL(str(Path(f'build/gdn_inverse_export_{name}/libno_workspace_kernel.so').resolve()),mode=os.RTLD_LOCAL|os.RTLD_DEEPBIND) for name in ('before','once','host')}
for lib in libs.values():
    lib.pto_launch_gdn_mega.argtypes=[argtypes[typ] for typ,name in parameters]
    lib.pto_launch_gdn_mega.restype=None
print(json.dumps({'libraries':{k:dict(path=v._name,sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(v._name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()) for k,v in libs.items()}}),flush=True)
aliases=dict(blockDim='block_dim',g_in='g',msk_lower='mask_lower',msk_full='mask_full',minus_id='minus_identity',o='out',fs='final_state',h0='initial_state',kkt_ws='kkt_workspace',wy_ws_a1='wy_workspace_a1',wy_ws_a2='wy_workspace_a2',h_ws='h_workspace',o_ws_qk='o_workspace_qk',o_ws_qs='o_workspace_qs',o_ws_gated='o_workspace_gated')

def measure(length,heads,key_heads):
    torch.manual_seed(42)
    q=torch.randn(1,length,key_heads,128,device='npu',dtype=torch.float16)*.1
    k=torch.nn.functional.normalize(torch.randn_like(q),dim=-1)
    v=torch.randn(1,length,heads,128,device='npu',dtype=torch.float16)
    g=-torch.rand(1,length,heads,device='npu')*.1
    beta=torch.rand_like(g).half()
    launch=_prepare_gdn_mega(q,k,v,g,beta,torch.tensor([0,length],device='npu',dtype=torch.int32))
    caches={str(dt).split('.')[-1]:torch.empty(length//128,heads,128,128,device='npu',dtype=dt) for dt in (torch.float32,torch.float16,torch.bfloat16)}
    pto_gdn_mega(**launch)
    reference=launch['out'].clone(),launch['final_state'].clone()
    extra=dict(stream=torch.npu.current_stream().npu_stream,num_heads=heads,num_key_heads=key_heads)
    variants=[]
    for name,cache in [*caches.items(),('none',None)]:
        values={**launch,**extra,'inverse_cache':cache,'inverse_cache_dtype':2 if cache is None else (torch.float16,torch.bfloat16,torch.float32).index(cache.dtype)}
        args=[values[aliases.get(n,n)] for typ,n in parameters]
        args=[x.data_ptr() if isinstance(x,torch.Tensor) else x for x in args]
        for version,lib in libs.items(): variants.append((version+'_'+name,lib.pto_launch_gdn_mega,args))
    torch.npu.synchronize()
    for label,call,args in variants:
        call(*args)
        torch.npu.synchronize()
        for field,expected in zip(('out','final_state'),reference):
            torch.testing.assert_close(launch[field],expected,atol=0,rtol=0)
    torch.npu.synchronize()
    samples={label:[] for label,_,_ in variants}
    for trial in range(24):
        order=variants[trial%len(variants):]+variants[:trial%len(variants)]
        if trial%2: order=order[::-1]
        for label,call,args in order:
            start=time.perf_counter(); call(*args); torch.npu.synchronize()
            if trial>=4: samples[label].append((time.perf_counter()-start)*1000)
    print(json.dumps(dict(tokens=length,heads=heads,key_heads=key_heads,samples_ms=samples,medians_ms={k:statistics.median(v) for k,v in samples.items()})),flush=True)

for shape in ((2048,16,2),(8192,16,2),(8192,64,16),(32768,64,16)):
    measure(*shape)
